title: Christmas Bird Counts
hook: Every year around Christmas time, since 1921, birdwatchers in the Hamilton area of Ontario have gone out and counted all the birds they see or hear in a day. They have been carefully recording this data, and the raw data is available through the website of Bird Studies Canada (twitter handle: @BirdsCanada). Sharleen has been a part of this data collection for the past two years, and decided to do some citizen data science with it! She went through and cleaned this data and made it much more ready for analysis! She detailed her data journey in a 5 part blog series as seen here. Many thanks to her for cleaning, visualizing, and then sharing it!
